pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-02.png with Read and looked at it. It has four panels: a full-width top tier, a middle tier split into a wide left panel and a narrower right panel, and a full-width bottom tier. Reading left to right and top to bottom. Panel 1 (top): the narration box at top centre reads 'The clinic begins its Welbuk onboarding.' Then the teal label box at top right reads 'WELBUK PRACTICE for the clinic'. One placeholder figure marked 'ananya' sits left of centre. She has no balloon, so this is a silent beat. Panel 2 (middle left): balloon at top left reads 'We can organise our clinic workflow here.' Its tail points right and down to the 'ananya' placeholder. Panel 3 (middle right): balloon at top reads 'And our team can use tools suited to each staff role.' Its tail points down to the small 'meera' placeholder. Then the teal label at lower left reads 'WELBUK CARE for clinic staff'. Panel 4 (bottom): the 'ananya' placeholder is left of centre, and the balloon to her right reads 'One team. Better coordination.' Its tail points left to ananya. The 'meera' placeholder to the right has no balloon: a silent reaction or presence. Page number '2' is at the bottom.
pages.observation: Order is clear. Each tier reads left then right, and no balloon pairs compete for the reader's eye. Inside panel 1, the narration box and the teal label sit side by side at the top. I read the narration first because it is further left, but the two could be read in either order. Who or what the label 'WELBUK PRACTICE for the clinic' belongs to is not shown at storyboard stage. The narration box at the top of panel 1 sits on the panel's top border and breaks it. The 'WELBUK PRACTICE' label touches both the top and right panel borders. In panel 3 the 'WELBUK CARE' label runs close to the panel's left border. In panel 4 the balloon's tail and left edge cover the 'ananya' placeholder label (the text reads as 'anany'), so in the art the balloon could touch her head. In panel 2 the tail tip touches the ananya placeholder box. Meera speaks in panel 3, then only appears silently in panel 4; there is no reply from her to 'One team. Better coordination.' That is acceptable as a silent reaction, but the art will need to show it. All text was readable.
